issues.title: Define gRPC & Protobuf contracts for Voice, RAG, MCP, and Call Events
issues.description:
### Context & Objective
Establish strongly-typed Protobuf v3 contracts shared across Spring Boot, Python (FastAPI), and Node.js (TypeScript) microservices.

### Technical Tasks
- [ ] Define `rag/v1/rag_service.proto` (`QueryChunksRequest`, `QueryChunksResponse` scoped by `tenant_id`)
- [ ] Define `mcp/v1/mcp_gateway.proto` (`ExecuteToolRequest`, `ExecuteToolResponse` with HTTP status, latency_ms, and sanitized output)
- [ ] Define `voice/v1/call_events.proto` (`CallStarted`, `TurnCompleted`, `ToolExecuted`, `CallEnded`, `HumanTransferRequested`)
- [ ] Setup `buf.yaml` / `protoc` generation scripts for Java, Python, and TypeScript

### Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] `buf lint` and `buf build` pass with zero breaking warnings
- [ ] Generated stubs compile cleanly in Java 21, Python 3.11, and TypeScript 5
- [ ] All request messages enforce `tenant_id` field for strict multi-tenancy

issues.title: Configure Spring Cloud Gateway routing, JWT validation & Redis rate limiting
issues.description:
### Context & Objective
Serve as the single ingress edge for `solter-web` and external REST API clients (`POST /v1/calls/outbound`), validating JWTs, Solter API Keys, and enforcing per-tenant rate limits.

### Technical Tasks
- [ ] Configure routes to `solter-tenant-service`, `solter-rag-service`, `solter-mcp-gateway`, `solter-voice-orchestrator`, `solter-telephony-bridge`, `solter-analytics-service`, and `solter-billing-service`
- [ ] Implement `JwtAndApiKeyAuthFilter` extracting `tenant_id`, `user_id`, and `roles` into downstream headers (`X-Tenant-Id`, `X-User-Id`)
- [ ] Configure Redis-backed `RequestRateLimiter` per `tenant_id` (returning HTTP 429 with `Retry-After`)
- [ ] Configure centralized CORS policy for `solter-web`

### Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unauthenticated requests to `/api/v1/**` return HTTP 401
- [ ] Valid Solter API key (`sltr_live_*`) routes `POST /v1/calls/outbound` with `X-Tenant-Id` header
- [ ] Exceeding per-tenant burst limit returns HTTP 429
- [ ] `/actuator/health` returns HTTP 200

issues.title: Implement OpenAPI aggregation & standardized RFC 7807 error responses
issues.description:
### Context & Objective
Aggregate downstream Swagger/OpenAPI specs and ensure consistent `404`, `409`, `429`, and `500` JSON error payloads for `solter-web`.

### Technical Tasks
- [ ] Configure SpringDoc OpenAPI Gateway aggregation
- [ ] Implement global `ErrorWebExceptionHandler` returning `{status, code, message, requestId, tenantId, timestamp}`
- [ ] Add unit & WebTestClient integration tests

### Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Gateway errors match RFC 7807 format expected by `solter-web` Error page
- [ ] Unit/integration tests pass with >80% coverage

issues.title: Implement Multi-Region Edge Routing & Super Admin Gateway Scope
issues.description:
### Context & Objective
Support geo-aware routing across regional voice/telephony clusters and isolate `/api/v1/admin/**` routes for internal Solter AI Super Admins.

### Technical Tasks
- [ ] Configure region-aware weighted/latency routing headers (`X-Solter-Region`)
- [ ] Enforce `ROLE_SUPER_ADMIN` + IP allowlist on `/api/v1/admin/**`

### Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Non-Super-Admin tokens hitting `/api/v1/admin/**` return HTTP 403
- [ ] Regional failover switches traffic automatically on downstream health check failure

issues.title: Setup Spring Boot, Flyway migrations & multi-tenant schema (users, orgs, agents, API keys)
issues.description:
### Context & Objective
Establish the core identity, workspace (`tenant_id`), Voice Agent configuration, and Solter API Key persistence layer in PostgreSQL.

### Technical Tasks
- [ ] Configure Flyway migrations `V1__init_tenant_schema.sql` for `organizations`, `users`, `org_memberships`, `voice_agents`, and `solter_api_keys`
- [ ] Implement `TenantContext` and strict `tenant_id` scoping on all queries
- [ ] Setup Docker Compose with PostgreSQL 15 & Redis 7
- [ ] Document endpoints in `/docs/API.md`

### Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] `mvn spring-boot:run` applies Flyway migrations cleanly
- [ ] `/actuator/health` returns HTTP 200
- [ ] Zero cross-tenant leakage in repository integration tests

issues.title: Implement Auth (Email/Password, OTP verification, JWT) & Workspace Hub APIs
issues.description:
### Context & Objective
Provide registration, login, OTP email verification, JWT refresh/revocation (Redis), and multi-organization Workspace Hub APIs.

### Technical Tasks
- [ ] `POST /api/v1/auth/register`, `/login`, `/verify-otp`, `/refresh`, `/logout`
- [ ] `GET /api/v1/workspaces` (list orgs user belongs to with role badges) & `POST /api/v1/workspaces` (create org)
- [ ] `POST /api/v1/workspaces/{id}/api-keys` & `POST .../rotate` (masked `sltr_live_••••`)

### Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Invalid credentials return HTTP 401; duplicate org/email returns HTTP 409
- [ ] Logout blacklists JWT in Redis immediately
- [ ] Unit & Testcontainers tests pass (>80% coverage)

issues.title: Implement Voice Agents Studio CRUD & configuration deployment APIs
issues.description:
### Context & Objective
Allow admins to create, clone, configure, and deploy Voice Agent personas (voice model, speaking speed, greeting, system prompt, linked KB collections, enabled MCP tools, and fallback phone number).

### Technical Tasks
- [ ] `GET/POST/PUT/DELETE /api/v1/agents` and `POST /api/v1/agents/{id}/clone`
- [ ] Enforce active agent slot limit from `solter-billing-service` (return HTTP 409 if slot limit reached)
- [ ] Publish agent config update to Redis cache for <3s live pickup by `solter-voice-orchestrator`

### Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Creating a 2nd active agent on Free tier returns HTTP 409 with upgrade metadata
- [ ] Saved agent config is readable from Redis by voice orchestrator
- [ ] Unit tests cover all validation & slot-limit edge cases

issues.title: Implement Customizable Role CRUD, User Role Assignment, BYOK Vault & Delete Organization
issues.description:
### Context & Objective
Support granular, customizable RBAC roles, per-user role assignment, AES-256 encrypted BYOK keys (for RAG & MCP LLMs), and permanent organization deletion.

### Technical Tasks
- [ ] `GET/POST/PUT/DELETE /api/v1/roles` with granular permission matrix (`agents:*`, `kb:*`, `mcp:secrets`, `calls:takeover`, `rbac:manage`, `org:delete`)
- [ ] Protect built-in `Owner` role from deletion (HTTP 409)
- [ ] `PUT /api/v1/members/{userId}/role` to assign custom roles
- [ ] `GET/PUT /api/v1/settings/byok` (AES-256 encrypted RAG embedding & MCP LLM keys, masked on read)
- [ ] `DELETE /api/v1/workspaces/{id}` requiring exact org name confirmation, revoking keys and cascading tenant deletion

### Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Custom roles enforce module permissions at API boundary (HTTP 403 when unauthorized)
- [ ] BYOK keys are encrypted at rest with AES-256 and never returned in plaintext
- [ ] Org deletion cascades cleanly and invalidates all tenant API keys

issues.title: Implement Contacts CRM, CSV Bulk Import & DNC Suppression APIs
issues.description:
### Context & Objective
Provide customer CRM CRUD, CSV/Excel bulk import with custom JSON metadata (`property_id`, `order_id`), segment filtering, and TRAI DND / workspace DNC suppression.

### Technical Tasks
- [ ] `GET/POST/PUT/DELETE /api/v1/contacts` and `POST /api/v1/contacts/import` (CSV parser)
- [ ] `PATCH /api/v1/contacts/{id}/dnc` to toggle Do-Not-Call flag
- [ ] Segment query endpoint for `solter-voice-orchestrator` campaigns

### Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Bulk CSV import maps phone, name, and custom metadata columns
- [ ] Contacts marked `dnc=true` are excluded from outbound campaign dialing

issues.title: Implement Enterprise SSO (SAML 2.0 / OIDC) & SCIM Directory Sync
issues.description:
### Context & Objective
Allow enterprise B2B tenants to authenticate via Okta, Google Workspace, or Azure AD using SAML 2.0 / OIDC and auto-provision users.

### Technical Tasks
- [ ] Configure Spring Security SAML 2.0 & OIDC client per `tenant_id` domain mapping
- [ ] Map IdP groups to Solter custom RBAC roles

### Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Users with configured SSO domain redirect to their IdP and receive a tenant-scoped JWT
- [ ] Integration tests verify SAML assertion parsing and role mapping

issues.title: Implement Super Admin Tenant Management, Limit Overrides & SOC2/DPDP Audit Exports
issues.description:
### Context & Objective
Enable internal Solter AI Super Admins to inspect tenants, override concurrency/rate limits, suspend abusive workspaces, and export immutable audit logs.

### Technical Tasks
- [ ] `GET /api/v1/admin/tenants`, `PATCH /api/v1/admin/tenants/{id}/limits`, `POST .../suspend`
- [ ] `GET /api/v1/admin/audit-logs/export` (JSON/CSV compliance bundle)

### Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] All Super Admin actions write immutable audit records with actor ID and reason
- [ ] Limit overrides propagate to Redis within 5 seconds

issues.title: Setup FastAPI, PostgreSQL + pgvector & tenant-scoped document schema
issues.description:
### Context & Objective
Scaffold the Python FastAPI RAG service with `pgvector` for tenant-isolated semantic search.

### Technical Tasks
- [ ] Configure FastAPI lifespan, `pydantic-settings`, SQLAlchemy async + `pgvector` extension
- [ ] Create `kb_documents` (id, tenant_id, filename, status: `Processing|Ready|Failed`, chunk_count, error_message) and `kb_chunks` (embedding vector, content, metadata) tables
- [ ] Implement `GET /health` checking DB & pgvector

### Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] `uvicorn main:app` boots cleanly and `GET /health` returns HTTP 200
- [ ] `pgvector` HNSW/IVFFlat index created with `tenant_id` filter

issues.title: Implement PDF/Markdown/TXT ingestion pipeline, BYOK embeddings & semantic retrieval API
issues.description:
### Context & Objective
Ingest uploaded documents (up to 20MB), chunk and embed using Org BYOK key or Solter managed tokens, and expose low-latency semantic retrieval.

### Technical Tasks
- [ ] `POST /api/v1/kb/documents` (multipart upload up to 20MB PDF/MD/TXT, async background extraction & embedding)
- [ ] `GET /api/v1/kb/documents` & `DELETE /api/v1/kb/documents/{id}` (immediate vector removal)
- [ ] `POST /api/v1/kb/retrieve` (returns top-k chunks with similarity score in <80ms, scoped by `tenant_id`)
- [ ] Fetch tenant BYOK embedding key from `solter-tenant-service` (fallback to platform key) and report token usage

### Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] 10-page PDF finishes indexing to `Ready` in <30 seconds
- [ ] Deleting a document immediately removes its chunks from retrieval results
- [ ] Pytest suite achieves >80% coverage with mocked embedding API

issues.title: Implement Live URL Crawling, Google Drive / Notion Sync & Scheduled Re-Indexing
issues.description:
### Context & Objective
Automatically sync live company help centers, Notion workspaces, and Google Drive folders on a configurable daily schedule.

### Technical Tasks
- [ ] Implement URL sitemap/recursive crawler with robots.txt compliance
- [ ] Implement Google Drive & Notion OAuth connector sync
- [ ] Add cron/scheduler for daily delta re-indexing without downtime

### Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Crawl job extracts clean markdown chunks and updates vectors atomically
- [ ] Changed pages re-index without removing existing live search availability

issues.title: Setup Spring Boot MCP Gateway, OpenAPI 3.0/3.1 parser & AES-256 secret vault
issues.description:
### Context & Objective
Parse uploaded OpenAPI 3.0/3.1 JSON/YAML specs into MCP tool definitions and store client API credentials encrypted with AES-256.

### Technical Tasks
- [ ] Integrate `swagger-parser` (`io.swagger.parser.v3`) to extract paths, HTTP methods, and flattened parameter schemas
- [ ] Implement AES-256-GCM encryption utility for `Authorization: Bearer` and static API Key headers
- [ ] Persist `mcp_specs`, `mcp_tools` (enabled boolean), and `mcp_secrets` scoped by `tenant_id`

### Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Valid OpenAPI 3.0 JSON/YAML parses endpoints within 5 seconds
- [ ] Secrets are encrypted at rest and masked (`sk-••••1234`) in all GET responses

issues.title: Implement MCP Tool toggle, Test Tool Sandbox & secure runtime execution proxy
issues.description:
### Context & Objective
Expose endpoints to toggle tools ON/OFF, test tools in a sandbox, and execute enabled tools mid-call with strict server-side credential injection.

### Technical Tasks
- [ ] `POST /api/v1/mcp/specs`, `PATCH /api/v1/mcp/tools/{id}/toggle`, `POST /api/v1/mcp/tools/{id}/test`
- [ ] `POST /api/v1/mcp/execute` (invoked by `solter-voice-orchestrator`): injects decrypted auth header at server boundary, enforces 4s timeout, logs HTTP status & latency
- [ ] Never return raw upstream credentials or stack traces to LLM prompt

### Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Disabled tools return HTTP 403 if invoked
- [ ] Upstream `500` or `>4s` timeout returns structured fallback error for graceful voice apology
- [ ] Unit & WireMock integration tests pass (>80% coverage)

issues.title: Implement OAuth 2.0 Auto-Refresh Token Flows & Visual Multi-Step MCP Workflows
issues.description:
### Context & Objective
Support OAuth 2.0 client-credentials/refresh-token flows for external CRMs and allow chaining multiple API calls into a single composite MCP tool.

### Technical Tasks
- [ ] Implement OAuth 2.0 token lifecycle manager with Redis lock during refresh
- [ ] Support composite workflow definitions (e.g. `check_availability` -> `book_visit` -> `send_whatsapp`)

### Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Expired OAuth tokens refresh transparently mid-call without dropping the request
- [ ] Composite workflows execute sequentially and roll back or report step failures cleanly

issues.title: Implement Partner MCP Pack SDK & Signed Connector Registry
issues.description:
### Context & Objective
Allow third-party developers and partners to publish verified, versioned MCP tool packs into the Solter Marketplace.

### Technical Tasks
- [ ] Define MCP Pack manifest schema, signature verification, and sandbox validation pipeline
- [ ] Expose `POST /api/v1/admin/mcp-packs/publish` and tenant 1-click install hydration

### Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unsigned or schema-invalid packs are rejected with HTTP 400
- [ ] Approved packs install into any tenant workspace in <2 seconds

issues.title: Implement real-time voice turn pipeline (<600ms latency, <200ms barge-in, filler speech)
issues.description:
### Context & Objective
Orchestrate streaming ASR -> RAG retrieval + LLM reasoning (with Org BYOK or platform tokens) -> MCP tool execution -> streaming TTS audio.

### Technical Tasks
- [ ] Build WebSocket/WebRTC audio stream handler with <200ms barge-in interruption cancellation
- [ ] Inject current date/time context so relative dates (e.g. 'next Thursday') resolve to `YYYY-MM-DD` and confirm aloud
- [ ] Trigger natural filler speech when an MCP tool call exceeds 400ms
- [ ] Handle prompt-injection guardrails & human-transfer intent detection

### Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] End-to-end turn latency p95 <600ms in benchmark tests
- [ ] Barge-in stops TTS playback within <200ms
- [ ] Failed/timed-out MCP tool triggers polite apology and human transfer offer

issues.title: Implement WebRTC Test Call Simulator, Outbound Campaigns & DNC/Window scheduler
issues.description:
### Context & Objective
Support in-browser WebRTC agent testing (`Test Agent`), programmatic outbound calls (`POST /v1/calls/outbound`), and scheduled outbound campaigns with TRAI DND & calling-window enforcement.

### Technical Tasks
- [ ] `POST /api/v1/calls/outbound` & `POST /api/v1/agents/{id}/webrtc-session`
- [ ] Campaign orchestrator (`GET/POST /api/v1/campaigns`, pause/resume) respecting calling windows (`09:00-20:00 IST`), DNC suppression, and retry backoff
- [ ] Enforce concurrent call slot limits via `solter-billing-service`

### Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] WebRTC test session streams audio + live transcript + MCP tool trace
- [ ] Campaigns skip DNC contacts and pause outside configured calling hours

issues.title: Implement Multi-Language Code-Switching (Hinglish/Hindi/Tamil) & Custom Voice Cloning
issues.description:
### Context & Objective
Support dynamic mid-call language switching (English, Hinglish, Hindi, Tamil) and tenant-uploaded custom brand voice cloning.

### Technical Tasks
- [ ] Integrate multilingual streaming ASR + language-aware TTS voice routing
- [ ] Add custom voice clone enrollment endpoint with explicit DPDP consent check

### Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Code-switched Hinglish utterances transcribe and respond naturally without <600ms SLA regression
- [ ] Voice cloning rejects requests without verified consent flag

issues.title: Implement Multi-Region Active-Active Orchestration & Graceful Degradation
issues.description:
### Context & Objective
Scale voice orchestration across multiple regions (ap-south-1, us-east-1, ap-southeast-1) with automatic LLM/TTS provider failover for 99.9%+ uptime.

### Technical Tasks
- [ ] Implement circuit breakers for primary/secondary LLM & TTS providers
- [ ] Support stateless Redis session handoff & regional health telemetry

### Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Simulated primary TTS/LLM outage fails over to secondary provider within 500ms
- [ ] Load tests sustain 500+ concurrent calls per region without audio jitter

issues.title: Implement Plivo/Exotel +91 inbound/outbound SIP & WebSocket media bridge
issues.description:
### Context & Objective
Connect India `+91` (Exotel/Plivo) and global SIP trunks to `solter-voice-orchestrator` with low-latency bi-directional audio streaming and human call transfer.

### Technical Tasks
- [ ] Handle inbound call webhooks, lookup routed Voice Agent by dialed number, and bridge media stream
- [ ] Implement outbound call dialer with 30s ring timeout and voicemail/no-answer detection
- [ ] Implement `POST /api/v1/telephony/transfer` to bridge live call to fallback human number
- [ ] Record call audio to object storage and emit call completion event within 10s

### Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Outbound call connects and streams PCM/Opus audio with <50ms bridge overhead
- [ ] Voicemail/no-answer hangs up cleanly and logs `No Answer` / `Voicemail`
- [ ] Vitest unit tests pass with mocked Plivo/Exotel SDKs

issues.title: Implement Phone Number provisioning CRUD & Live Call Whisper/Takeover controls
issues.description:
### Context & Objective
Allow admins to provision/assign phone numbers & custom SIP trunks, and allow supervisors to Whisper or Takeover live active calls.

### Technical Tasks
- [ ] `GET/POST/PATCH /api/v1/phone-numbers` (assign inbound number -> Voice Agent; return HTTP 409 on conflict)
- [ ] `POST /api/v1/calls/{id}/whisper` & `POST /api/v1/calls/{id}/takeover`

### Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Assigning a number already bound to another agent returns HTTP 409
- [ ] Supervisor takeover bridges audio cleanly without dropping the customer

issues.title: Implement Bring-Your-Own-Carrier (BYOC) SIP Trunking & TLS/SRTP Encryption
issues.description:
### Context & Objective
Allow enterprise clients to connect their existing Twilio, Asterisk, or Cisco SIP trunks directly with encrypted TLS/SRTP signaling.

### Technical Tasks
- [ ] Build BYOC SIP trunk configuration & health-ping verification endpoint
- [ ] Support SRTP media encryption and custom SIP headers

### Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Verified BYOC trunk routes inbound/outbound calls with SRTP enabled
- [ ] Invalid SIP credentials return structured diagnostic error

issues.title: Implement Global Multi-Carrier Failover & Automatic Health-Based Rerouting
issues.description:
### Context & Objective
Monitor carrier MOS/SIP 5xx rates in real time and automatically failover outbound/inbound routing between Plivo, Exotel, and Twilio.

### Technical Tasks
- [ ] Track per-carrier SIP error rate & jitter in Redis
- [ ] Auto-reroute outbound calls to healthy backup carrier on carrier degradation

### Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Simulated carrier 503 outage triggers automatic failover on the next dial attempt
- [ ] Super Admin telemetry reflects live carrier health

issues.title: Implement Call Logs ingestion, Transcript/Audio metadata & MCP Execution Trace APIs
issues.description:
### Context & Objective
Persist every completed call within 10 seconds of hangup, including recording URL, speaker-separated timestamped transcript, AI summary, turn latency, and MCP tool execution logs.

### Technical Tasks
- [ ] Flyway schema for `call_logs`, `call_transcript_turns`, and `mcp_execution_traces` scoped by `tenant_id`
- [ ] `GET /api/v1/calls` (searchable, filterable by status `Completed|Transferred|Voicemail|Failed|Live`)
- [ ] `GET /api/v1/calls/{id}` returning metadata, recording URL, transcript, and tool trace (`200 OK` / `4xx` / `5xx`)
- [ ] Trigger outbound tenant webhooks (`call.completed`, `tool.executed`) with HMAC signature

### Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Completed calls appear in `GET /api/v1/calls` within 10s of hangup
- [ ] Webhook delivery retries with exponential backoff on non-2xx responses

issues.title: Implement Executive Dashboard KPIs, Latency Percentiles (p50/p95) & BPO ROI Analytics
issues.description:
### Context & Objective
Aggregate call volume, resolution rate (>75% target), p50/p95 turn latency, top triggered MCP tools, and cost-per-resolved-call savings vs human BPO.

### Technical Tasks
- [ ] `GET /api/v1/analytics/overview` & `GET /api/v1/analytics/latency` (p50/p95)
- [ ] `GET /api/v1/analytics/tools` (top MCP tools & success/failure rates)

### Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Queries execute in <150ms using indexed rollups
- [ ] Unit & Testcontainers tests pass (>80% coverage)

issues.title: Implement Automated QA Scoring, Customer Sentiment Graphs & CRM Auto-Sync (Salesforce/HubSpot)
issues.description:
### Context & Objective
Score every call automatically for script adherence, sentiment trajectory, and sync call outcomes/transcripts directly to Salesforce or HubSpot.

### Technical Tasks
- [ ] Post-call LLM QA evaluator generating `qa_score` (0-100) and sentiment timeline
- [ ] HubSpot & Salesforce CRM sync worker on `call.completed` event

### Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] QA score & sentiment data appear on Call Detail & Analytics APIs
- [ ] CRM sync logs delivery status and retries on transient errors

issues.title: Implement Super Admin Platform-Wide Health, Latency Spike & Failed Integration Telemetry
issues.description:
### Context & Objective
Provide the internal Solter AI Super Admin team with cross-tenant visibility into global p95 latency spikes, failed MCP integrations, and system uptime.

### Technical Tasks
- [ ] `GET /api/v1/admin/telemetry/health`, `/latency-spikes`, and `/failed-tools`
- [ ] Real-time alerting hooks (Slack/PagerDuty) when global p95 exceeds 600ms

### Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Cross-tenant telemetry strictly requires `ROLE_SUPER_ADMIN`
- [ ] Alert triggers within 30 seconds of sustained latency breach

issues.title: Implement Redis atomic Concurrency Slot Manager & Minute/Token Usage Metering
issues.description:
### Context & Objective
Enforce plan-based concurrent call slots (Free: 1 slot, Growth: 5, Pro: 10+) and track voice minutes + RAG/MCP token usage in real time.

### Technical Tasks
- [ ] Redis atomic acquire/release slot endpoints (`POST /api/v1/concurrency/acquire`, `/release`)
- [ ] `GET /api/v1/billing/usage` returning live concurrent slots, voice minutes, and RAG/MCP tokens

### Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Exceeding concurrent slot limit returns HTTP 409/429 with current vs max slots
- [ ] Slot acquire/release executes in <5ms via Redis

issues.title: Implement Razorpay/Stripe Subscriptions, Invoices & Marketplace Add-ons
issues.description:
### Context & Objective
Support plan upgrades (Free -> Growth -> Pro), add-on concurrency slots, downloadable PDF invoices, and 1-click Marketplace pack installs.

### Technical Tasks
- [ ] `GET /api/v1/billing/plans`, `POST /api/v1/billing/checkout`, `POST /api/v1/billing/webhooks` (signature verified)
- [ ] `GET /api/v1/billing/invoices` & `GET /api/v1/marketplace/packs`, `POST /api/v1/marketplace/install`

### Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Forged webhook signatures return HTTP 400
- [ ] Successful checkout updates tenant concurrency slots immediately

issues.title: Implement Partner Marketplace Revenue Share & Super Admin Billing/Credit Controls
issues.description:
### Context & Objective
Support partner payouts for paid Marketplace MCP packs and allow Solter Super Admins to issue promotional credits or custom enterprise contracts.

### Technical Tasks
- [ ] `POST /api/v1/admin/billing/{tenantId}/credits` & custom enterprise slot/minute overrides
- [ ] Partner revenue ledger for paid Marketplace pack installations

### Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Super Admin credit adjustments reflect immediately on tenant invoices
- [ ] Partner ledger unit tests pass with >80% coverage

issues.title: Setup React architecture, constants, shared API client, i18n, theme & reusable UI primitives
issues.description:
### Context & Objective
Establish the strict component-based React 18 + TypeScript + Tailwind foundation following `.github/docs/GUIDELINES.md` and the approved HTML designs in `designs/`.

### Technical Tasks
- [ ] Create single constants files: `src/constants/app.constants.ts` (feature flags `IS_FEATURE_ENABLED`, `IS_MOCK_DATA`) and `src/constants/api.constants.ts` (all API endpoints)
- [ ] Create centralized API utility `src/services/api.ts` (error handling, auth headers, loading state)
- [ ] Setup `i18next` localization (`src/locales/en.json`) with zero hardcoded UI strings
- [ ] Build reusable shared components: `AppShell` (collapsible sidebar, separate Support nav, mobile bottom bar, org switcher, concurrency pill, Light/Dark toggle), `Loader`, `Modal`, `Toast`, `Badge`, `ScrollableTable` (`white-space: nowrap` for phone numbers), and `LazySection`

### Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Zero direct `fetch`/`axios` calls inside page components
- [ ] Theme toggle & responsive layout match approved `designs/assets/solter-ui.css`
- [ ] Vitest unit tests pass for shared components & API client

issues.title: Implement Auth, OTP Verification, Workspace Hub & Executive Dashboard pages
issues.description:
### Context & Objective
Implement onboarding and executive overview screens matching `designs/auth.html`, `designs/workspaces.html`, and `designs/dashboard.html`.

### Technical Tasks
- [ ] Build `AuthPage` (Login, Sign Up, 6-digit OTP step, SSO buttons)
- [ ] Build `WorkspacesPage` (Org Switcher with Owner/Admin/Operator badges & Create Org modal)
- [ ] Build `DashboardPage` (KPI cards, 7-day SVG chart, concurrency gauge, recent calls table)

### Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Supports `IS_MOCK_DATA=true` and live API modes seamlessly
- [ ] Unit tests cover auth flows, workspace switching, and dashboard rendering

issues.title: Implement Voice Agents Studio (with WebRTC Test Simulator) & Call Logs / Live Monitor
issues.description:
### Context & Objective
Implement `designs/voice-agents.html` and `designs/call-logs.html` using modular, reusable components.

### Technical Tasks
- [ ] Build `VoiceAgentsPage` (slot meter, agent cards, voice/speed/prompt/KB/MCP form, WebRTC Test Call modal)
- [ ] Build `CallLogsPage` (Call History + Live Calls tabs, Whisper/Takeover controls, audio waveform player, transcript & MCP tool execution trace)

### Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Phone numbers in tables never wrap (`ScrollableTable`)
- [ ] Unit tests verify agent form validation and call log detail inspection

issues.title: Implement Knowledge Base & MCP Gateway (OpenAPI parser + Sandbox) pages
issues.description:
### Context & Objective
